# Santa Fe Painting Workshops

> > A premier art education platform offering in-person retreats, online classes, and painting techniques instruction led by artist Andrea Cermanski in Santa Fe, New Mexico.

Santa Fe Painting Workshops provides comprehensive art education through live retreats near Canyon Road, online courses via Thinkific covering color theory and abstraction, and an extensive blog library on painting techniques and creative practice. The site features Andrea Cermanski's original abstract paintings and serves artists at all levels seeking professional development and creative transformation.

## Core Programs

- [Homepage](https://santafepaintingworkshops.com): Homepage for Santa Fe Painting Workshops art classes and retreats
- [Online Classes by Andrea Cermanski](https://santafepaintingworkshops.com/classes): Online painting classes on color, composition, and abstraction via Thinkific
- [Online Programs by Andrea Cermanski](https://santafepaintingworkshops.com/online-programs): Online art courses in color, composition, and abstraction for all levels
- [Retreats](https://santafepaintingworkshops.com/retreats): Art retreats and team building classes in downtown Santa Fe near Canyon Road
- [1-Day Retreat](https://santafepaintingworkshops.com/1day-retreat): One-day art retreat in Santa Fe with Andrea Cermanski

- [About](https://santafepaintingworkshops.com/about): About Andrea Cermanski and Santa Fe Painting Workshops philosophy
- [Paintings](https://santafepaintingworkshops.com/paintings): Andrea Cermanski's abstract paintings and canvas art prints for sale

## Painting Tutorials & Techniques

- [Easy Acrylic Painting Ideas](https://santafepaintingworkshops.com/easy-acrylic-painting-ideas): Three beginner-friendly acrylic painting tutorials with step-by-step instructions
- [Make Your Own Pour Medium](https://santafepaintingworkshops.com/make-your-own-pour-medium): Step-by-step tutorial for making DIY acrylic pour painting medium
- [How to Avoid Muddy Colors in Abstract Painting](https://santafepaintingworkshops.com/avoid-muddy-colors): Article on color theory techniques to avoid muddy colors in abstract painting
- [Paint Better with Right Brain Mode](https://santafepaintingworkshops.com/right-brain-painting): Article on accessing right brain mode for improved painting and creativity

## Blog & Creative Advice

- [Blog Hub](https://santafepaintingworkshops.com/blog): Blog hub featuring painting tips, techniques, and art advice articles
- [Perfectionism in Abstract Painting](https://santafepaintingworkshops.com/perfectionism-in-abstract-painting): Article on overcoming perfectionism and creative blocks in abstract painting
- [How to Make Time for Your Art](https://santafepaintingworkshops.com/how-to-make-time-for-your-art): Seven strategies for prioritizing creativity and art-making practice
- [Does the Price of a Paintbrush Matter?](https://santafepaintingworkshops.com/does-the-price-of-a-paintbrush-matter): Guide comparing paintbrush quality, materials, and affordable vs premium options
- [Art Supplies for a Small Budget](https://santafepaintingworkshops.com/art-supplies-for-a-small-budget): Guide to affordable acrylic painting supplies and budget-friendly recommendations
